overall: The AG found the Franklin Board of Assessors violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to distribute, execute, and retain its members' certification forms, and ordered certification and future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to complete the Open Meeting Law certification forms required of its members.
allegations.key_passage: Following our review, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to distribute, execute and retain the certification forms of each Board member.

remedy: Within 30 days of receipt of the letter, each Board member must certify, on the AG-approved form, receipt of the Open Meeting Law, the AG's regulations, and the AG's Open Meeting Law Guide.
Within 30 days of receipt of the letter, the Board must certify to the AG's Office that it has complied with the certification order.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law is required, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation.
remedy_passage: We also order the Board to certify to this Office within thirty (30) days of receipt of this letter that they have complied with this order. Finally, we order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution the Board that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of an intentional violation of the law.
